Context: 5. Emoluments and Average Emoluments

3. If he had been under suspension and subsequently reinstated in service without forfeiture of service or was on EOL on MC, the emoluments which he would have drawn had he not been under suspension or absent from duty will be taken as emoluments.
4. If he had been on extraordinary leave, the period whereof does not count as service, emoluments drawn immediately before proceeding on such leave will be taken as emoluments.
